important_limits: No absolute cosmic rest frame or physical universal 'forward' exists here; chosen frame direction may be freely rotated.
Adding equal bulk velocity to all objects does not generate extra gravitational attraction, delay, mass, or a change in gravitational field.
The Sun is physically offset from Sagittarius A* and also orbits it; fixed 'behind' persists only if its relative position is held constant or the forward projection stays negative.
Sgr A* apparent sky motion is mostly solar reflex; do not confuse it with center-of-Galaxy bulk velocity.
No gravitational interaction is computed for every star, because masses and 6D phase space are missing.
729 are coordinate sampling stations, not physically rigid orbiting stars. The orbital mode's intermediate spoke markers are kinematic geometry only.
Linear common translation is a Galilean Newtonian modeling transformation; accelerating/noninertial frames introduce fictitious inertial terms.
The torus is a logical combinatorial ring and rank→station mapping does not identify worldline time, actual star position, or cosmic topology.
Earth's 1AU phase is illustrative and does not replace a Solar System ephemeris.
Initial alignment of the Sun 8.277 kpc behind the chosen heading is a deliberate coordinate choice, not a measured alignment of the Sun with the Galaxy's actual peculiar motion.
